story.en: ...Oh. We meet again. Don't tell me you followed me.

story.text: 비행기에서 '목소리' 다르다고 했죠? …여기선 방송 안 하니까 그런가 봐요.
story.reading: bi-haeng-gi-e-seo 'mok-so-ri' da-reu-da-go haess-jyo? …yeo-gi-seon bang-song an ha-ni-kka geu-reon-ga bwa-yo.
story.en: You said my 'voice' sounds different on the plane, right? ...Guess it's because I'm not making an announcement here.

story.text: '방송'할 땐 원래 이런 목소리예요. 차분하게, 흔들림 없이. 손님들 불안하게 하면 안 되니까.
story.reading: 'bang-song'hal ttaen won-lae i-reon mok-so-ri-ye-yo. cha-bun-ha-ge, heun-deul-lim eobs-i. son-nim-deul bul-an-ha-ge ha-myeon an doe-ni-kka.
story.en: When I do the 'announcement', this is just my normal voice. Calm, steady. Can't make the passengers anxious.
'Normally'... it's a bit lower than that. Like right now.

story.text: 왜 그런지 '이유'는 나도 몰라요. …손님 앞이라 그런가.
story.reading: wae geu-reon-ji 'i-yu'neun na-do mol-la-yo. …son-nim ap-i-ra geu-reon-ga.
story.en: I don't even know the 'reason' why. ...Maybe it's because I'm in front of you.

story.text: 이런 얘기, '처음' 해봐요. 그래서, 그게 왜 궁금해요?
story.reading: i-reon yae-gi, 'cheo-eum' hae-bwa-yo. geu-rae-seo, geu-ge wae gung-geum-hae-yo?
story.en: This is the 'first' time I've talked about this. So, why are you curious about that anyway?

story.text: …뭘 그렇게 웃어요. 자, 오늘 배운 단어들 문제로 확인해 봐요.
story.reading: …mwol geu-reoh-ge us-eo-yo. ja, o-neul bae-un dan-eo-deul mun-je-ro hwag-in-hae bwa-yo.
story.en: ...What are you smiling about. Come on, let's check today's words with some questions.

words.example_en: That person's voice is very calm.
Is this your first time in Jeonju?

sentences.en: Your voice is lower than usual.
I felt reassured after hearing the announcement.
I'll tell you the reason later.
This is a first for me.
